beats: Every morning, hundreds of job listings piled into my feeds. Sorting them by hand ate four hours a day.
It was exhausting, biased, and slow — good matches got buried under the pile, and burnout crept in.
So I built an Edge Function that reads each listing against my own CV and scores the fit.
The hot ones get flagged and delivered straight to my phone within seconds.
Four hours became under thirty minutes — a ninety percent drop in wasted time.
